Oratorios.
1812.
Messrs. Ashley
Most respectfully inform the Nobility, Gentry, and Public, that the Season will
Commence as usual, at the
Theatre-Royal, Covent-Garden,
On Thursday next,
The 30th Instant,
When will be performed
A Grand Selection of Sacred Music.
Part I.
Overture [unreadable]-Recit. Mr. Bellamy 'My cup is full.' Air, 'Shall I in Mamre's.' Chorus 'For all these
mercies.' Joshua-Air, Mrs. Bland 'No more with unavailing' Bach-Air, Mrs. Dickons and Chorus 'The mar-
vellous work.' Creation-Motet, Signor Tramezzani 'I am refurgam.' Mayer-Chorus 'When his loud voice.' Jeph.
-Air, Madam Catalani 'Angels ever bright.' Theodora-Chorus 'Fix'd in his everlasting feat.' Samson.
Part II.
Overture and Dead March in Saul-Quartetto, Mrs. Bland, Mess. Goss, Broadhurst and Tinney 'When the ear
heard him.' Chorus 'But his name liveth.' Funeral Anthem-Duet, Madam Catalani and Signor Tramezzani
'In questo lieto' Pueitta-Rocit, Mrs. Dickons 'And God said.' Air, 'With verdue clad.' Chorus 'Awake the
harp.' Creation-Air, Madam Catalani 'Holy, holy Lord.' Redemption-Chorus 'Join voices.' Gaillard & Cooke
-Duet, Mr. Dickons & Mrs Bland 'Quoniam tu folus.' Portogallo-Chorus 'Gird on thy sword.' Saul.
Part III.
Introduction-Air, Mr. Goss and Chorus 'Jehovah renown'd.' Esther-Recit. Mrs Dickons 'Ye sacred priests.'
Air, 'Fairwell ye limpid springs.' Jephtha-Cavitina, Signor Tramezzani-Chorus 'Te glorious.' Graun-Air,
Madam Catalani 'Gratias agimus.' Guiglielmi-Coronation Anthem, 'God save the King.'
Principal Performers.
Madam Catalani,
Mrs. Bland,
And Mr. Dickons,
SignorTramezzani,
Mr. Goss, Mr. Broadhurst, Mr. Tinney, And Mr. Bellamy,
Leader of the Band, Mr. Ashley-Organ, Mr. J. Ashley
The remainder of the Band and the Choruses,
By the most approved Performers.
Doors to be opened at Six. begin at Seven-Half Price at Nine-Boxes 7s-Pit 3s 6d-Gal. 2s-Up Gal 1s.
Places for the Boxes to be taken of Mr. Brandon, at the Box-Office in Hart-street.
